title: Redux Toolkit 现代实践
html:
Redux Toolkit 现代实践

核心概念

Redux Toolkit (RTK) 是 Redux 的官方推荐工具包，简化了 Redux 的使用，同时保留了其可预测性。

graph TD
    A[Redux Toolkit] --> B[createSlice]
    A --> C[configureStore]
    A --> D[createAsyncThunk]
    A --> E[RTK Query]
    B --> F[Reducer + Actions]
    C --> G[Store + 中间件]
    D --> H[异步操作]
    E --> I[数据获取 + 缓存]

RTK vs 传统 Redux

特性 RTK 传统 Redux
代码量 少 多
配置 简单 复杂
Immer 内置 需要手动
TypeScript 优秀 一般
DevTools 内置 需要配置

RTK Query

创建 API Slice

import { createApi, fetchBaseQuery } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react';

interface Todo {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  completed: boolean;
}

export const todoApi = createApi({
  reducerPath: 'todoApi',
  baseQuery: fetchBaseQuery({ baseUrl: '/api' }),
  tagTypes: ['Todo'],
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    getTodos: builder.query<Todo[], void>({
      query: () => '/todos',
      providesTags: ['Todo'],
    }),
    getTodo: builder.query<Todo, string>({
      query: (id) => `/todos/${id}`,
      providesTags: (result, error, id) => [{ type: 'Todo', id }],
    }),
    addTodo: builder.mutation<Todo, string>({
      query: (text) => ({
        url: '/todos',
        method: 'POST',
        body: { text },
      }),
      invalidatesTags: ['Todo'],
    }),
    updateTodo: builder.mutation<Todo, { id: string; text?: string; completed?: boolean }>({
      query: ({ id, ...patch }) => ({
        url: `/todos/${id}`,
        method: 'PATCH',
        body: patch,
      }),
      invalidatesTags: (result, error, { id }) => [{ type: 'Todo', id }],
    }),
    deleteTodo: builder.mutation<void, string>({
      query: (id) => ({
        url: `/todos/${id}`,
        method: 'DELETE',
      }),
      invalidatesTags: ['Todo'],
    }),
  }),
});

export const { useGetTodosQuery, useGetTodoQuery, useAddTodoMutation, useUpdateTodoMutation, useDeleteTodoMutation } =
  todoApi;

使用 Query

import {
  useGetTodosQuery,
  useAddTodoMutation,
  useUpdateTodoMutation,
  useDeleteTodoMutation
} from './api'

function TodoList() {
  const { data: todos, isLoading, error } = useGetTodosQuery()
  const [addTodo] = useAddTodoMutation()
  const [updateTodo] = useUpdateTodoMutation()
  const [deleteTodo] = useDeleteTodoMutation()
  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('')

  const handleAdd = async () => {
    if (inputText.trim()) {
      await addTodo(inputText)
      setInputText('')
    }
  }

  const handleToggle = async (todo: Todo) => {
    await updateTodo({
      id: todo.id,
      completed: !todo.completed
    })
  }

  if (isLoading) {
    return <div>Loading...</div>
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div>Error: {error.message}</div>
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <input
        value={inputText}
        onChange={(e) => setInputText(e.target.value)}
        onKeyPress={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleAdd()}
      />
      <button onClick={handleAdd}>Add</button>
      <ul>
        {todos?.map((todo) => (
          <li key={todo.id}>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={todo.completed}
              onChange={() => handleToggle(todo)}
            />
            {todo.text}
            <button onClick={() => deleteTodo(todo.id)}>Delete</button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  )
}

配置 Store

import { configureStore } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';
import { todoApi } from './api';
import counterReducer from './counterSlice';

export const store = configureStore({
  reducer: {
    [todoApi.reducerPath]: todoApi.reducer,
    counter: counterReducer,
  },
  middleware: (getDefaultMiddleware) => getDefaultMiddleware().concat(todoApi.middleware),
});

export type RootState = ReturnType<typeof store.getState>;
export type AppDispatch = typeof store.dispatch;

RTK 基础

Slice

import { createSlice, createAsyncThunk, PayloadAction } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';

interface CounterState {
  value: number;
  status: 'idle' | 'loading' | 'succeeded' | 'failed';
  error: string | null;
}

const initialState: CounterState = {
  value: 0,
  status: 'idle',
  error: null,
};

export const incrementAsync = createAsyncThunk('counter/incrementAsync', async (amount: number) => {
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
  return amount;
});

const counterSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'counter',
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    increment: (state) => {
      state.value += 1;
    },
    decrement: (state) => {
      state.value -= 1;
    },
    incrementByAmount: (state, action: PayloadAction<number>) => {
      state.value += action.payload;
    },
  },
  extraReducers: (builder) => {
    builder
      .addCase(incrementAsync.pending, (state) => {
        state.status = 'loading';
      })
      .addCase(incrementAsync.fulfilled, (state, action) => {
        state.status = 'succeeded';
        state.value += action.payload;
      })
      .addCase(incrementAsync.rejected, (state, action) => {
        state.status = 'failed';
        state.error = action.error.message || 'Something went wrong';
      });
  },
});

export const { increment, decrement, incrementByAmount } = counterSlice.actions;
export default counterSlice.reducer;

使用 Slice

import { useSelector, useDispatch } from 'react-redux'
import { RootState, AppDispatch } from './store'
import { increment, decrement, incrementByAmount, incrementAsync } from './counterSlice'

function Counter() {
  const count = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.counter.value)
  const status = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.counter.status)
  const dispatch = useDispatch<AppDispatch>()

  return (
    <div>
      <p>Count: {count}</p>
      <p>Status: {status}</p>
      <button onClick={() => dispatch(increment())}>+</button>
      <button onClick={() => dispatch(decrement())}>-</button>
      <button onClick={() => dispatch(incrementByAmount(5))}>+5</button>
      <button onClick={() => dispatch(incrementAsync(10))}>
        {status === 'loading' ? 'Loading...' : 'Async +10'}
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}

常见误区

❌ 误区 1：仍然使用传统 Redux

新项目直接使用 Redux Toolkit，不要手写 Action 和 Reducer。

❌ 误区 2：不使用 RTK Query

API 调用使用 RTK Query，不要自己写 async thunk。

❌ 误区 3：忘记 invalidatesTags

RTK Query 中正确配置 invalidatesTags 来自动刷新数据。

小结

mindmap
  root((Redux Toolkit))
    createSlice
      Reducer + Actions
      Immer 内置
      TypeScript 推断
    createAsyncThunk
      异步操作
      三种状态
      错误处理
    RTK Query
      数据获取
      自动缓存
      代码生成
    configureStore
      默认中间件
      DevTools 集成
  • Redux Toolkit 是现代 Redux 的标准写法
  • createSlice 自动生成 Reducer 和 Actions
  • RTK Query 替代了手动管理服务器状态的需求
